arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/vps-final-proof.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch hygiene/vps-passive-supervisor-only-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/published"
test "$(git -C "$tmp/published" rev-parse HEAD)" = 6ba5b8110bf121ae74fa06e4ea1e361511e85ff8
test "$(git -C "$tmp/published" rev-parse HEAD^)" = 3567f4a6fc86c7139287fdcbd1bf0c81335150a5
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch hygiene/vps-passive-supervisor-only-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/expected"
cd "$tmp/expected"
git checkout --quiet --detach HEAD^
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3567f4a6fc86c7139287fdcbd1bf0c81335150a5
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast
workflow=Path(".github/workflows/agent-switch.yml")
assert workflow.is_file()
workflow.unlink()
obsolete=Path("ops/tests/test_codex_resume_stage_routing.py")
assert obsolete.is_file()
obsolete.unlink()
changed=[]
for file in sorted(Path("ops/tests").glob("test_*.py")):
 tree=ast.parse(file.read_text())
 lines=file.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
 removed=[]
 for item in tree.body:
  if isinstance(item,ast.ClassDef):
   for method in item.body:
    if isinstance(method,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and method.name.startswith("test_"):
     source="".join(lines[method.lineno-1:method.end_lineno])
     if "agent-switch.yml" in source:
      from_line=min([method.lineno]+[d.lineno for d in method.decorator_list])
      removed.append((from_line,method.end_lineno,method.name))
 if removed:
  for start,end,name in sorted(removed,reverse=True):
   del lines[start-1:end]
  file.write_text("".join(lines))
  changed.append((str(file),[m[2] for m in removed]))
file=Path("ops/tests/test_portable_coordinator_retirement.py")
s=file.read_text()
old='''    "codex-autonomous-validation.yml",
)
INERT_WORKERS = (
    "agent-switch.yml", "codex-autonomous.yml",
'''
new='''    "codex-autonomous-validation.yml", "agent-switch.yml",
)
INERT_WORKERS = (
    "codex-autonomous.yml",
'''
assert s.count(old)==1
file.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
print("ROUTER_WORKFLOW_REMOVED",flush=True)
print("RETIRED_OBSOLETE_TEST_FILE",str(obsolete),flush=True)
for path,names in changed:print("RETIRED_ROUTER_TESTS",path,",".join(names),flush=True)
PY
python3 - "$tmp/expected" "$tmp/published" <<'PY'
import sys,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
expected,published=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3])
cmd=['git','-C',str(expected),'diff','--binary','--no-ext-diff','--no-renames','HEAD']
a=subprocess.check_output(cmd)
b=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(published),'diff','--binary','--no-ext-diff','--no-renames','HEAD^','HEAD'])
print('EXPECTED_DIFF_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),flush=True)
print('PUBLISHED_DIFF_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),flush=True)
print('PUBLISHED_EXACT_MATCH',a==b,flush=True)
if a!=b:
 print('EXPECTED_CHANGED',subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(expected),'diff','--name-status','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),flush=True)
 print('PUBLISHED_CHANGED',subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(published),'diff','--name-status','HEAD^','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),flush=True)
PY
cd "$tmp/published"
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
python3 -m unittest -q ops.tests.test_portable_coordinator_retirement ops.tests.test_telegram_gateway ops.tests.test_supervisor_live ops.tests.test_supervisor_cloud_source ops.tests.test_supervisor_audit > "$tmp/focused.log" 2>&1
python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q > "$tmp/full.log" 2>&1
python3 - "$tmp/focused.log" "$tmp/full.log" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
for name in sys.argv[1:]:
 data=Path(name).read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 for line in data:

   print('PUBLISHED_TEST',Path(name).name,line[:200],flush=True)
 assert any(line=='OK' for line in data),name
PY
